text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 9: Forecasts of a demand series follow its daily pattern but can sit well above or below its level'
text.tspan: Figure 9: Forecasts of a demand series follow its daily pattern but can
sit well above or below its level

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Black line: actual power of Demand 1. Coloured lines: each forecast's ensemble mean (the average of the 51 ensemble members), as a percentage of the series' effective capacity. Zero is no power. Each panel shows one forecast run from the weekly runs of the validation year (July 2025 to June 2026), chosen by the actual power alone and not by forecast error. Panels run from the run with the highest mean actual power (top) to the lowest (bottom). The series is the lower- middle one of its type when ranked by the cleaned production forecast's mean normalised CRPS (continuous ranked probability score) over the 53 weekly runs.'
text.tspan: Black line: actual power of Demand 1. Coloured lines: each forecast's ensemble mean (the average of the 51 ensemble
members), as a percentage of the series' effective capacity. Zero is no power.
Each panel shows one forecast run from the weekly runs of the validation year (July 2025 to June 2026), chosen by
the actual power alone and not by forecast error.
Panels run from the run with the highest mean actual power (top) to the lowest (bottom). The series is the lower-
middle one of its type when ranked by the cleaned production forecast's mean normalised CRPS (continuous ranked
probability score) over the 53 weekly runs.
